title: CriticVerdict
description: Produced by the per-cycle Critic for each Synthesizer output. Pass / revise / reject plus per-claim issues.

push_back_suggestion.description: For labored_rotation_push_back_candidate: which lower-layer change would eliminate the friction?

lesson.description: Optional cross-cycle pattern note appended to lessons.md.

exercised_checks.description: Per-check audit of which substantive checks (#1-#11 from the Critic prompt) were engaged on this cycle's content. REQUIRED on pass verdicts (per meta-review #8 plan item 2; promotion from prose-subsection introduced in meta-review #6). Each entry is a one-line note: `check #N (name): exercised at <where>` OR `check #N: trivially carried from prior layer / not applicable`. Optional on revise/reject verdicts (the issues array already structures what was wrong). Empty array means 'no checks exercised' (sanity-fail — would be unusual on a pass).

check.description: Which numbered check from the Critic prompt was considered.

outcome.description: exercised = the check actually evaluated content; trivially_carried = the prior layer's resolution still holds; not_applicable = the check's preconditions don't apply to this slice.

note.description: Optional one-line note (e.g., 'pc_side absorbed via constructed-operator, single dispatch site verified').
